headlines.title_en: Netherlands moves 86 tons of gold reserves from US/Canada to London for rapid access in crises
headlines.summary_en: The Dutch central bank has transferred approximately $12 billion worth of gold reserves from New York in the U.S. and Ottawa in Canada to London, citing concerns over escalating global geopolitical turmoil. Between March and August this year, the Dutch central bank moved about 86 tonnes of gold to London, accounting for over a quarter of its gold reserves previously stored in the U.S. and Canada. London now holds nearly one-third of the Netherlands' gold reserves, making it the largest storage location.

headlines.title_en: Commerce Ministry: China-Egypt trade up 23.2% year-on-year in first seven months
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce said today that China-Egypt economic and trade cooperation has entered a "fast track," with bilateral trade volume growing 23.2% year-on-year in the first seven months of this year. China has been Egypt's largest trading partner for 14 consecutive years. Bilateral trade reached $20.79 billion in 2025, a record high. From January to July this year, bilateral trade reached $13.75 billion, up 23.2% year-on-year. Driven by policies such as China's full zero-tariff treatment for African countries with diplomatic ties, Egyptian specialty products like fresh oranges and flax have seen rapid export growth to China, showing strong momentum. (CCTV)

headlines.title_en: Argentina's FM: Must use all available means to achieve sovereignty over Falklands
headlines.summary_en: Argentine Foreign Minister Pablo Kiernan said on September 2 local time that Argentina must use all available means to achieve sovereignty over the Malvinas Islands (referred to as the Falkland Islands by the UK). Speaking at a think tank event in Buenos Aires, Kiernan stated that the Malvinas are Argentine territory, and Argentina must leverage every available approach to maximize national interests and achieve the common goal of all Argentines—sovereignty over the Malvinas. When asked whether it is possible to regain control of the Malvinas, Kiernan said: "There is always a chance; we are getting closer to the goal." It is reported that Argentine President Milei will deliver a national televised address on the Malvinas issue on the evening of the 3rd. Kiernan hinted that Milei's speech will cover Argentina's sovereignty claim over the Malvinas and sanctions on foreign companies exploiting natural resources on the islands and surrounding waters.

headlines.title_en: UK 10-year gilt yield hits highest since 2007, briefly near 5.29%
headlines.summary_en: On Wednesday (September 2) during late European trading, the UK 10-year government bond yield rose 0.8 basis points to 5.228%, reaching 5.289% at 17:15 Beijing time, approaching the Q3 2007 peak of 5.564%, the Q1 2000 high of 5.899%, and the Q1 1998 high of 6.307%, with gains notably pared back between 19:00-20:00. The 2-year gilt yield rose 1.0 basis point to 4.616%. The 30-year gilt yield rose 0.9 basis point, and the 50-year gilt yield rose 1.0 basis point. The 2/10-year gilt yield spread was roughly flat at +61.400 basis points.

headlines.title: 摩根大通：贝森特将日本央行逼入加息的进退两难困境
headlines.summary: 在美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特发起公开施压行动之后，日本央行行长植田和男在临近本月政策决议之际，面临着异常严峻的金融市场动荡风险。 摩根大通证券首席日本经济学家藤田绫子（Ayako Fujita）表示：“在美国如此明确表态之后，如果日本央行不采取行动，将会是个问题。但如果市场认为日本央行没有美国的顺风就无法加息，那就会对加息的有效性构成重大风险。”“当前长期利率的上升速度，其实并非日本央行的过错。真正能同时遏制日元走弱和长期利率上升的，是政府发出可信的财政信号。”

headlines.title_en: JPMorgan: Bessent pushes Bank of Japan into rate-hike dilemma
headlines.summary_en: Following a public pressure campaign launched by U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda faces exceptionally severe financial market volatility risks approaching this month's policy decision. Ayako Fujita, chief Japan economist at JPMorgan Securities, said: "After such explicit statements from the U.S., it would be a problem if the BOJ does not act. But if the market thinks the BOJ cannot raise rates without a tailwind from the U.S., that poses a major risk to the effectiveness of a hike." "The current speed of long-term rate increases is not really the BOJ's fault. What can truly curb both yen weakness and rising long-term rates is a credible fiscal signal from the government."

headlines.summary: 美联储褐皮书显示，自7月初以来，美国经济活动温和增长。12个联储辖区中，10个地区录得轻微至温和增长，2个地区没有变化。消费支出小幅增加，但消费者价格敏感度提高，高端消费保持强劲；汽车销售受到信心疲软、高油价和融资成本上升影响而表现低迷。制造业活动在多数地区回升，部分地区称国防和数据中心相关订单需求强劲。就业市场增长放缓，整体仅略有增加，制造业、建筑业等领域劳动力需求较好，但零售和酒店行业需求下降。价格方面，多数地区报告物价温和上涨，能源、运输、原材料及关税带来的成本压力仍在。企业预计未来经济前景总体积极，但对能源价格、政策和国际冲突带来的不确定性保持关

headlines.title_en: Fed's Beige Book: economic outlook generally positive but uncertainty rises
headlines.summary_en: The Fed's Beige Book shows that U.S. economic activity grew modestly since early July. Of the 12 Fed districts, 10 reported slight to modest growth, while 2 saw no change. Consumer spending increased slightly, but consumers grew more price-sensitive, with high-end spending remaining strong; auto sales were sluggish due to weak confidence, high fuel prices, and rising financing costs. Manufacturing activity picked up in most districts, with some reporting strong demand related to defense and data center orders. Employment growth slowed, increasing only slightly overall, with solid labor demand in sectors like manufacturing and construction, but declining demand in retail and hospitality. On prices, most districts reported moderate increases, with ongoing cost pressures from energy, transportation, raw materials, and tariffs. Businesses expect a broadly positive economic outlook, but remain cautious about uncertainties from energy prices, policy, and international conflicts.
